title: Bandana
text: “Theo's making a pretty realistic suggestion there. If you win too big, they might not let you leave the venue, huh?”

Ah, I've heard of that, indeed. Apparently if you win too spectacularly, they won't let you leave until you make some kind of massive purchase. To avoid this, you apparently need connections with famous merchants, even in Zeltoble. Well, but if you have that kind of connection, they'll get suspicious of you, so you might not be able to earn as much. Across all the previous loops, I've gotten acquainted with various merchants, and Father himself has even become a famous merchant. Anyway, this was happening in a back alley while Father, the slaves, and I were on our way back to the branch office in Zeltoble.
“…Seems like some strange pursuers have latched onto us.”
“Yeah, they've been following us for a while now.”
Crocodile Guy said with a sigh as we reached the depths of the alley.
“I heard footsteps following us.”
“Vauuu…”
“So it's true after all, huh? I did have a feeling we were being tailed somehow.”
Seemed everyone was in agreement, indeed.
“Panda and Elmelo did warn us to be careful, but I didn't think they'd actually come at us so suddenly. Did Shion cause too much of a ruckus?”
“Who knows.”

Apparently the coliseum Crocodile Guy had participated in this time was an underground one, arranged so that Elephant could join without issue. Being able to get in on a single introduction from Elephant was proof of just how much sway Elephant held, indeed. Probably the judgment was that only an opponent of that caliber could match Crocodile Guy.
“So what should we do in a situation like this?”
“Apparently striking back is fine. Looks like they're trying to avoid witnesses and ambush us anyway… how thoughtful of them, surrounding us and all.”
“Given the sort of place this is, I was prepared for it, but there really are scum everywhere, aren't there.”
Crocodile Guy spat out the words.
“Shion, sure there are plenty of bad people, but I think there are even more good ones out there than that… you know?”
“I know. I haven't given up on the world quite that much.”

As if to say Father needn't worry, Crocodile Guy drew out his axe and readied himself. I recall that Father from the very first world used to lament that the world was full of nothing but villains. He truly despaired of the world back then, indeed.
“Uuuuu…!?”
Wolf, on the other hand, seemed restless, glancing all around. What was wrong? Father, noticing this unusual unease, tried to calm him down.
“How long are you planning to hide? We already know you're there, so come on out. Otherwise we can't even head home, can we.”
Rabbit Guy called out to the group that had been approaching.
“Buboo…”
“Bubu-bubi-hee!”
And then, shuffling into view, appeared a group of pigs that seemed somehow familiar, indeed.
Oh? There seemed to be one mixed among the pigs capable of speech, indeed.
“Hah! Getting cocky just because you cheated your way to a win, huh?”

Ahh… I see, going by that appearance, that's the true form of the griffin that was among Takt's entourage, indeed. Which means… gah! Takt's Dragon Emperor is here too, indeed. If it gets any closer, Rival might end up possessing it, so I'd best keep my distance while mercilessly slaughtering it without a second thought, indeed.
“Vo… Vowoooooooooo! Gaaaaaaaa!”
“Wolf!? What's wrong? Calm down!”
Wolf, staring at the pigs, suddenly let out an excited howl, and Father tried to restrain him.
“You lot are… the women who were making a fuss watching the match, aren't you… attacking us just because the man you were cheering for got beaten by us is a rather extreme response, don't you think.”

Ahh, I see, indeed. Takt must have been competing under some ring name like Ball Seven or whatever, and got beaten by Crocodile Guy. Hmm… so I've buffed him up quite a bit, but it seems his stats have risen enough to beat Takt now. Quite the growth, indeed.
“If you don't want to get hurt, go home. This is getting pathetic.”
“Bububuhi! Bubbu!”
One of the pigs screeched.
“How dare you! Our Takt bought out the venue and weakened him to the maximum, and you still had the nerve to win—what are you even talking about!”

We did no such thing, indeed. There's no way an impromptu entrant like Crocodile Guy, who hadn't rigged anything behind the scenes, could have received any buffs in an underground coliseum without prior arrangements, indeed. If anything, he'd factored in all that backstage scheming just to enter the match at all. As for Takt, he was so conceited about his own strength that he probably got cocky thinking he could win the championship even with debuffs and no rigging. Incidentally, in that one loop, Takt near the end had been throwing money around to buy enhancement magic just to challenge me. Zash, zash… from behind the pigs, from the shadow of a building, out stepped Takt, wearing that same insufferably smug face as always.
“Hmph. Cowardly small fry… what is this, nothing but a bunch of dudes all lined up? How disgustingly unkempt.”

And so Takt appeared. Just looking at him made me want to vomit, indeed. But well, a moth flying straight into the flame—since we're meeting him here, I suppose it's rather convenient timing, indeed. Still, unkempt, he says… you've got nothing but pigs around you. Come to think of it, Father from some world once mentioned being told by a guy surrounded by nothing but pigs, “What a creepy dude, dragging around nothing but women.”

Fufufu… Takt, I've been mulling over just how I should make you suffer this loop, indeed. Ordinary suffering simply won't satisfy me, you see? Your screams of agony shall become a requiem for the Filolial-samas, indeeeeeeeed… fufufufufufu.
“Um… I'm a little concerned about the guy over there radiating an unbelievably evil killing intent.”
“Ah… I too find the presence drifting from behind them far more terrifying than those guys themselves. I don't even want to ask what's going on.”
“Motoyasu-kun? Um…”

Father and the others looked my way, worry etched on their faces, as if sensing my aura. But shouldn't they be paying more attention to Takt's group than to me? Not one of them shall be allowed an easy death. For every Filolial-sama egg those wretches destroyed, they must suffer horribly before being killed, indeed.
“Vau! Gaaaaaaaa!”
“Wolf! Calm down! Listen to me!”

Father kept commanding him to stop, over and over, but Wolf showed no sign of settling down. More important than that right now was figuring out how to dispose of Takt as brutally as possible, indeed.
“Bubuhi? Bubububuhya-bubu!”
A pig wearing a red hood, mixed in among the group, watched restless Wolf and let out some kind of cry.
“Ahn? Ah, right, there was a guy like that. The gutless mutt who used to shake and tremble like a coward whenever he stood before me.”
Takt looked at Wolf with utter contempt, as if agreeing with something.
“Never thought I'd find a mangy dog mixed in with a bunch of cowards. Perfect match, really.”
“You lot… you know Wolf?”
“Wolf, huh? Quite the fancy name they gave you, considering all you were ever good for was shaking and trembling like the coward you are.”
“Gaaaaaaaaaa!”
Wolf let out a howl at Takt's provocation.
“Bubuhi, bububu, buhya!”

Little Red Riding Hood Pig was rattling on about something, but I couldn't understand a word of it, indeed. From what Father and the others gathered, it seemed this pig and Wolf had some kind of history between them. What became clear later was that she'd been taunting him along the lines of “What's a spineless wolf who got discarded as a failed experiment in body modification doing in a place like this?” If I recall, Wolf's ring name before he became damaged goods was Coward. So I suppose that means it was a ring name Takt had given him.
“No way… Wolf was made to endure this by them…”
Father stood there dumbfounded, and Crocodile Guy and the others, disgusted by their attitude, let killing intent flare as they readied themselves.
“Gaaaaaaaa!”
“Ah! Wolf!”
Shaking off Father's attempt to stop him, Wolf charged straight at Takt.
